title: Changed together
description: Which modules are changed together in one work session: the coupling between and within the modules of the cluster partition, and the work sessions that cross module boundaries.
author: fm-lab core

params.name: person
params.description: Person key from v_change_meta_authors (spelling variants merged).

params.name: days
params.description: Period counted back from the data state: 7, 30, 90, 365 or all (default).

params.name: coupling
params.description: Module coupling table: between (default, module pairs) or within (one module).

params.name: mq
params.description: Search term over the module names of the coupling table.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the coupling table (1-based, 100 rows per page).

params.name: spage
params.description: Page of the session list (1-based, 100 rows per page).
